name: Spotube
hook: Open source Spotify client — no Premium, no Electron, no ads.
bullets: Uses Spotify's free API + YouTube for audio — no Premium needed
Native Flutter app, not Electron — fast and lightweight
Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS
setupSteps: Download Spotube for your platform from GitHub or F-Droid
Sign in with your Spotify account (or use guest/anonymous login)
Browse, search, and play — ads-free, no Premium required
details: Spotube is an open-source, cross-platform Spotify client built with Flutter. It uses Spotify's free data API for metadata and YouTube (or Piped/JioSaavn) as an audio source, eliminating the need for Spotify Premium. The app features time-synced lyrics, offline downloads, anonymous login support, and zero telemetry or data collection. It's a native app — not another Electron wrapper — so it's lightweight, fast, and uses minimal resources. Spotube is licensed under BSD-4-Clause and has a thriving community with over 48k GitHub stars.
setup: Install the app, no server needed
